meta.name: i18n-glossary-sync
meta.description: Maintain a canonical i18n glossary file — sync new terms across all language pairs, detect drift, flag missing translations, and enforce consistent terminology across the codebase.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动同步多语言词汇表，保持翻译一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要维护多语言术语一致性
copy.tagline_en: Auto-sync i18n glossary files for consistent translations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs consistent multilingual terminology

howto.what: 当你提供 i18n 翻译文件路径和术语表后，Claude 会对比实际翻译与术语表，找出不一致、缺失翻译和新出现的术语，并生成更新术语表的建议。
howto.when: 在提取翻译字符串、完成翻译或每次发布时，你要求进行术语一致性检查或同步术语表时触发。

say.text: 检查我们项目的 i18n 术语一致性
say.note: 对比术语表并报告问题

say.text: 帮我同步术语表，更新缺失的翻译
分析当前翻译文件中的术语使用情况

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes i18n translation files against a canonical glossary, detects inconsistencies, missing translations, new terms, and deprecated terms, and proposes an update to the glossary.
howto.when_en: Triggered after translation extraction, post-translation, or at each release when you ask to check or sync the glossary, providing locales path, glossary path, and domain terms.

say_en.text: Check our project's i18n term consistency.
say_en.note: Compares against glossary and reports issues.

say_en.text: Sync the glossary and update missing translations.
Analyze term usage in current translation files.
